display.description: Logical display number (starting from 1) — used to select a specific monitor when multiple are attached

bus.description: I2C bus number (e.g., 4 for /dev/i2c-4); omit to use first detected monitor

hiddev.description: hiddev device number for USB-connected monitors (e.g., 0 for /dev/usb/hiddev0)

usb.description: USB bus.device number (e.g., '1.5' for bus 1, device 5)

sn.description: Serial number string (ASCII field from EDID), not binary serial

show_unsupported.description: Include unsupported features in getvcp output when querying groups

show_table.description: Include Table-type features in getvcp/vcpinfo output

rw.description: Filter to show only 'rw', 'ro', or 'wo' (read-write/read-only/write-only) features

maxtries.description: Retry counts for read/write/multi-part operations (e.g., '5', '10', or '.' to leave unchanged)

sleep_multiplier.description: Multiplier for DDC/CI spec waits (e.g., 0.8 for faster, 1.2 for slower); adjust for poorly-behaved monitors

noverify.description: Skip verification of VCP values after setvcp or loadvcp. Default is --noverify (true).

skip_ddc_checks.description: Assume DDC communication works and rely on invalid-feature flag

use_file_io.description: Force use of write()/read() I/O interface instead of ioctl (recommended for NVIDIA proprietary driver)

force_slave_address.description: Force takeover of in-use slave addresses (only with --use-file-io)

mccs.description: MCCS version (e.g., '2.1') to tailor command behavior

enable_usb.description: Enable USB-MCCS support (only if ddcutil built with USB support). Default is --disable-usb.

ignore_usb_vid_pid.description: List of USB vendor:product IDs to ignore (e.g., ['1234:5678', 'abcd:ef01'])

ignore_hiddev.description: List of hiddev device numbers to ignore (e.g., [0, 1])

enable_capabilities_cache.description: Enable caching of monitor capabilities for performance. Default is --enable-capabilities-cache.

enable_dynamic_sleep.description: Enable dynamic adjustment of sleep multipliers. Default is --enable-dynamic-sleep.

enable_cross_instance_locks.description: Coordinate I2C access across multiple ddcutil invocations. Default is --enable-cross-instance-locks.

syslog_level.description: Minimum syslog level: debug|verbose|info|notice|warn|error|never. Default is WARN if omitted.

stats.description: Execution stats to report (e.g., 'all', 'errors', 'time'). If omitted, no stats are reported.

vstats.description: Per-display stats (same values as stats). If omitted, no stats are reported.

istats.description: Internal + per-display stats (same values as stats). If omitted, no stats are reported.

edid_read_size.description: Force EDID read size: 128 or 256 bytes. Default is 256.

i2c_source_addr.description: Custom I2C source address in hex (e.g., '50')

enable_udf.description: Enable user-defined feature definitions. Default is --enable-udf.

discard_cache.description: Cache to discard: 'capabilities'|'dsa'|'all'. This is an action flag, not a persistent setting.
